newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-CURRIE CUP QUARTER-FINAL RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CURRIE CUP QUARTER-FINAL RESULTS.

text.p: Results from two quarter-final matches in the Currie Cup rugby union competition played on Friday night.
In Pretoria: Northern Transvaal beat Boland 55-23 (halftime 17-6).

Northern Transvaal - Tries: Joost van der Westhuizen, Henry Tromp, F.A. Meiring, Krynauw Otto, Willie Enslin, Hannes Venter, Kobus Engelbrecht. Conversions: Lance Sherrell (4). Penalties: Sherrell (4).
Boland - Tries: Johnie Trytsman, Elmo Wolfaardt. Conversions: Francois Horn (2). Penalties: Horn (3).
In Bloemfontein: Free State beat South-Eastern Transvaal 21-3 (12-3).
Free State - Tries: Chris Badenhorst, Werner Swanepoel. Conversion: M.J. Smith. Penalties: Smith (3).
